t: Universal espagnolette window handle supplied with a choice of 5 clip-in spindle lengths (9mm, 15mm, 30mm, 43mm and 55mm). Rose conceals an internal 90° stop to prevent gearbox over-stressing. Colour-matched, edge-to-edge screw cap covers the whole of the rose, resulting in minimal, modern sight lines. Push-button assembly and finger grips for user ease and comfort. Manufactured from high performance zinc alloy.
